reasoning_content: The dashboard is at `/en/admin/dashboard`. Let me access it with a session cookie and check whether it loads properly.

action.command:
cd /tmp
echo "=== Authenticated dashboard page (session from login) ==="
curl -s -b wj.txt --max-time 90 http://localhost:3000/en/admin/dashboard -o /tmp/dash.html -w "GET /en/admin/dashboard (authed): HTTP %{http_code}\n"
echo "size: $(wc -c < /tmp/dash.html)"
grep -oiE 'dashboard|club|<h1[^>]*>[^<]*' /tmp/dash.html | sort -u | head -8
echo
echo "=== Unauthenticated access to dashboard (should redirect to login) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 30 http://localhost:3000/en/admin/dashboard -w "no session -> HTTP %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"
